Summarize expected stock biology

Source: R/population_biology.R
stock_biology.Rd

Summarize expected stock biology

stock_biology(sim)

Arguments

sim

A population simulation from sim_abundance().

Value

A list with keyed data tables at_age (year and age) and at_length (year and native length group). Both contain mean_weight_kg (kg per fish), prop_mature (fraction of fish mature), and mean_mature_weight_kg (expected mature kg per fish, with immature fish contributing zero). The age table also has mean_length in cm.

Details

These expectations use the population's growth key and weight and maturity relationships. Age-specific expectations are defined by the biological model even in years with zero fish at that age. Length groups with no fish have missing maturity summaries. Weight at each length is supplied by the population's weight model.

Use mean_mature_weight_kg with abundance to reproduce expected mature biomass. Multiplying separately averaged weight and maturity can give a different result when both depend on length.

See also

age_means() for estimates from sampled fish.

Examples

population <- sim_abundance(ages = 1:3, years = 1:2)
stock_biology(population)$at_age
#> Key: <year, age>
#>     year   age mean_length mean_weight_kg  prop_mature mean_mature_weight_kg
#>    <int> <int>       <num>          <num>        <num>                 <num>
#> 1:     1     1    15.52713     0.03066238 0.0001358161          5.022218e-06
#> 2:     1     2    25.47551     0.14043603 0.0026256645          4.838541e-04
#> 3:     1     3    34.48037     0.35688380 0.0373478112          1.827784e-02
#> 4:     2     1    15.52713     0.03066238 0.0001358161          5.022218e-06
#> 5:     2     2    25.47551     0.14043603 0.0026256645          4.838541e-04
#> 6:     2     3    34.48037     0.35688380 0.0373478112          1.827784e-02
